notes: Per-100g values for the 12 classes the model is trained on.

Nigerian dishes are sourced from the West African Food Composition Table (FAO, 2019) and Nigerian Food Composition Table (2017); values for composite dishes are approximations of a typical home preparation and will vary with recipe, oil content and palm oil use.
Food-101 categories are sourced from USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy / Survey FNDDS).
default_portion_g is the typical single serving used when portion size cannot be estimated from the image.
